database-tests.root_cause: Trusted verification 358 passes every SQL fixture, including the repaired pinned Solo 2 renewal, then its unchanged concurrency harness creates default Solo and attempts a second-seat invitation. The approved catalog now defaults to Solo 1 with one seat; correctly denying that invitation is not a product failure. This harness specifically tests reservation/acceptance serialization at two seats. Select exact current Solo 2 monthly through the existing owner billing notice and authenticated operator approval RPC using disposable local test identities, then assert the selected variant, interval and active_members=2 before racing. Preserve all original single-winner assertions, all six resource ceilings, customer/supplier and location reactivation races, and fixture cleanup; retain real Solo 1 quota enforcement in the required task SQL. An independent local run of this exact repaired harness passes all races. This authorizes only the exact source-bound verifier repair and re-verification of execution 324, not product implementation, PASS, owner authority or hosted operations.
